findings.label: 添加状语和施动者
findings.chinese: 【例如】，【留学的】学生不会受到【思乡之情带来的】困扰。
findings.english: For example, when some students study abroad, they would not be bothered by the problem of homesickness.
problems: 关键词「studying abroad (留学)」的英文「studying abroad」未完整出现在答案中

findings.label: 添加插入语和修饰语
findings.chinese: 另一方面，许多人认为【良好的】心理素质【在很大程度上】决定了【体育】比赛的结果。
findings.english: On the other hand, many people believe that a good mentality, to a great extent, determines the results of sports competitions.
problems: 中文含「一方面」相关含义，英文未见 ['on the one hand'] 等对应

findings.label: 添加条件状语
findings.chinese: 具体而言，志在夺牌的运动员必须在整个比赛中保持冷静，或者【即使面对艰难险阻也不】轻易放弃。
findings.english: More specifically, athletes aiming at winning medals must be able to stay calm throughout the game or not easily give up the game even in an uphill battle.
problems: 中文含「尽管|虽然|即使」相关含义，英文未见 ['in spite of', 'despite', 'although', 'though'] 等对应

findings.label: 添加过渡词
findings.chinese: 【首先，】居家办公能显著节省员工的时间。
findings.english: Firstly, it is time-saving for employees to work at home.
problems: 中文含「极大地|显著|大大」相关含义，英文未见 ['much', 'greatly', 'significantly', 'remarkably'] 等对应

findings.label: 纯净主干
findings.chinese: 我认为这种工作方式会引发更多问题。
findings.english: I am of the opinion that this way of working causes more problems.
problems: 关键词「be of the opinion that (认为)」的英文「be of the opinion that」未完整出现在答案中

findings.label: 纯净主干
findings.chinese: 他们更容易患上肥胖症或高血压。
findings.english: They are more likely to be attacked by obesity or hypertension.
problems: 中文含「简化|更容易|更便捷|更方便」相关含义，英文未见 ['easier', 'easy', 'simplify', 'simplifies'] 等对应

findings.label: 添加原因状语从句
findings.chinese: 【由于整天缺乏户外活动，】他们更容易患上肥胖症或高血压。
findings.english: They are more likely to be attacked by obesity or hypertension, as they spend the whole day without any outdoor activities.
problems: 中文含「简化|更容易|更便捷|更方便」相关含义，英文未见 ['easier', 'easy', 'simplify', 'simplifies'] 等对应

findings.label: 纯净主干
findings.chinese: 父母就能自由地做自己想做的事。
findings.english: Their parents are free to do what they want.
problems: 关键词「be free to do (自由地做)」的英文「be free to do」未完整出现在答案中

findings.label: 纯净主干
findings.chinese: 他们更能意识到重要性。
findings.english: They are more aware of the importance.
problems: 关键词「be aware of (意识到)」的英文「be aware of」未完整出现在答案中

findings.label: 添加结果从句
findings.chinese: 这种负面情绪即使对成年人来说也难以应对，【对年幼的孩子而言更是巨大的挑战】。
findings.english: Such a negative emotion is difficult to deal with even for adults, so it is a larger challenge for young children.
problems: 中文含「尽管|虽然|即使」相关含义，英文未见 ['in spite of', 'despite', 'although', 'though'] 等对应

findings.label: 纯净主干
findings.chinese: 教育孩子始于家庭环境，且这是父母的责任。
findings.english: Educating them always begins in the home and is widely thought to be the responsibility of parents.
problems: 中文含「儿童|孩子」相关含义，英文未见 ['children', 'child', 'kids'] 等对应

findings.label: 添加修饰语
findings.chinese: 【教育孩子理解遵守规则、尊重他人的必要性】始终始于家庭环境，且【普遍认为】这是父母的责任。
findings.english: Educating them to understand the need to obey rules and respect others always begins in the home and is widely thought to be the responsibility of parents.
problems: 中文含「儿童|孩子」相关含义，英文未见 ['children', 'child', 'kids'] 等对应

findings.label: 添加过渡词
findings.chinese: 【换言之】，教育孩子理解遵守规则、尊重他人的必要性，始终始于家庭环境，且普遍认为这是父母的责任。
findings.english: In other words, educating them to understand the need to obey rules and respect others always begins in the home and is widely thought to be the responsibility of parents.
problems: 中文含「儿童|孩子」相关含义，英文未见 ['children', 'child', 'kids'] 等对应

findings.label: 添加修饰语
findings.chinese: 孩子【很可能】【给社区】带来【诸多】麻烦。
findings.english: Children are likely to cause the community a lot of trouble.
problems: 关键词「be likely to (很可能)」的英文「be likely to」未完整出现在答案中

findings.label: 添加条件状语从句
findings.chinese: 【如果孩子们无法参与角色扮演游戏】，又怎能培养想象力？
findings.english: If they cannot play make-believe games, how can they develop their imagination?
problems: 中文含「儿童|孩子」相关含义，英文未见 ['children', 'child', 'kids'] 等对应
